items.title: An unauthenticated call is a 401 naming where the authorization server is
The pointer resolves to protected resource metadata naming the issuer
A client registers dynamically and receives an identifier
An operator pre-authorizes the registered client's scopes
items.requirement: IronAuth admin consent; MCP authorization client approval

items.title: A public client is exempted from the DPoP-by-default posture
A login yields a token bound to the MCP server it was requested for
The bound token is accepted by the server it names
The same token replayed at another MCP server is refused

items.title: A call missing the tool scope is a 403 naming the scope to request
